blocks.content: Earlier, you learned to add spacing between flex items using the gap property.
While gap adds fixed spacing between items, justify-content distributes space dynamically based on item alignment.
The list below summarizes all values for justify-content:

items: flex-start: Aligns items at the start of the main axis (default).
flex-end: Aligns items at the end of the main axis.
center: Centers items along the main axis.
space-between: Distributes items evenly, with the first item at the start and the last at the end.
space-around: Distributes equal space between items, and half of this space at the edges.
space-evenly: Distributes items evenly, with equal space around each item, including the outer edges.
